verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official CLI (crates/buzz-cli) with documented commands for channels, repos and branch protection, and workflow triggers and approvals. It is built for AI-native use: the ACP harness has agents reply through the Buzz CLI, and a vendor-packaged "buzz-cli" skill teaches agents to drive it, including `buzz agents draft-create`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented.
